basic_info.description: The dramatic brick arch will sweep your heart away and immediately set the stage for your home as being 1-of-1, dominated by unique character that gives joy in living somewhere special.  The renaissance of the Dogpatch neighborhood just keeps getting better, and this rare 1 bed/2 bath brick & timber conversion condo at Esprit Park has it all and puts you in the center of the action to enjoy all the fabulous Dogpatch shops & restaurants, easy proximity to Chase Center and Oracle stadium events, or perhaps a short stroll to newly renovated Esprit Park w/ your dog. This stunning, sought after loft with exposed brick and timber beams showcases a dramatic open living space with large industrial windows and custom ironwork detailing, yet provides an intimate warmth and coziness like being wrapped in a blanket.  The home is complete with a luxury kitchen, radiant heat, in-unit laundry, 1 car parking, storage locker, secure bike and parcel rooms, and electric car charger accessibility. Add'l HOA amenities include Google Fiber internet, a gym, theater, & daily cleaning. This Dogpatch home is a walker's paradise, centrally located to 3rd St. & 22nd St. commercial corridors, the Chase Center, Crane Cove Park, Mission Bay, Potrero Hill, Caltrain, Muni T-Line, and the 101 & 280 hwys.
